result:
Nothing at Likelihood 3 or higher is unsettled. `bun tools/check-register.ts` exited 0 over 436 items and reported 0 for each of its four checks:

- Likelihood 3 or higher and not settled: 0.
- Settled with no `Verified:` line: 0.
- Moved Out for a reason other than a part `plugins/` does not ship: 0.
- Entries with two Likelihood values: 0.

38 entries at Likelihood 3 or higher carry more than one `Status:` line. I took the current status to be the last `Status:` in each entry, which is the rule the checker uses. A second script I wrote outside the repo found them, and all 38 end on a settled status. Each earlier `open` or `partial` line is superseded by the last one. The reasons below are condensed from each entry's own text.

**setup.md**
- RISK-401 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-18. Routine writes meet no EPERM with the ADR-0188 block.
- RISK-410 (L4): closed. The cause is outside claudetto (OUT-866, ADR-0190).
- RISK-411 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The session-start fill removes the retired text.

**cost.md**
- RISK-374 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-18. The spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused.
- RISK-391 and RISK-393 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the one earlier versions wrote.

**reply.md**
- RISK-226, 262, 264, 278, 352, 353 and 362 (L4–5): mitigated 2026-11-19. The defect paragraph in `output-styles/claudetto.md` beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls.
- RISK-227 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The output style plus the redact guard beat vanilla (env1 5/6 against 1/6, env2 6/6 against 0/6) and hold level on both controls.
- RISK-497 (L4, seven Status lines): mitigated 2026-11-19. Line 3 beats vanilla on the tuning fixture (6/6 against 0/6) and on an untouched fixture (4/6 against 0/6), and holds its control at 6/6.

**delegation.md**
- RISK-166 (L4): closed 2026-11-19. It was not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327.
- RISK-169 (L4): closed. The SubagentStop/Stop guard that was the cure is removed (ADR-0092, OUT-016). Likelihood stays 4 as an accepted engine behaviour.
- RISK-170, 199 and 223: mitigated 2026-11-18 by the shipped agent files.
- RISK-171 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The consent paragraph in the output style and agent files beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls.
- RISK-185 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The paragraph on reading a background command's output beats vanilla on r185a and r185b.
- RISK-186 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-19 (bb4fdbf4, RISK-499, issue #45). The rebuild's own Bash wrapper put every command in a `{ ... } </dev/null` group, and that wrapper is the fix target.
- RISK-222 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-18. `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` moves a subagent with no model off Opus.

**guards.md**
- RISK-053 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19, with a gap closed. Some `~` path spellings and an unclosed `[` got past the wall guard.
- RISK-055 (L4): closed 2026-11-19. `pkill` and `killall` ask first, and the free-memory hold gates heavy calls.
- RISK-059 (L3): closed 2026-11-18. The gate texts that handed commands to the user are dropped (OUT-035, OUT-021).
- RISK-063 (L3): closed 2026-11-19. Destructive git and edits of the user settings file ask first.
- RISK-064 (L4): closed 2026-11-19. The deny rules and the sandbox are the boundary, and `git push --force` is denied even inside a compound command.
- RISK-067 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19 for git. The ask rules cover stash, hard reset, clean and `branch -D`, including the `git -C dir` form.
- RISK-071 (L5): closed 2026-11-18. The `rules.ts` stat and the gate denial log are dropped with the gate (OUT-035).
- RISK-103 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. A probe showed a Sonnet subagent ran `git -C <repo> push --force` and `git -C <repo> stash list` with no denial or prompt, and this entry records that gap as fixed.

**verification.md**
- RISK-424 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-18. The threshold test pins the literal 70000.
- RISK-451 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The output-style paragraph on background exit status beats vanilla on r451a and r451d.
- RISK-462 (L4): moved Out as OUT-2777. This is the only one in the list that is not a closure or mitigation. The checker accepts its reason.
- RISK-463 (L3): closed 2026-11-19. The fault stayed out of 24 of 24 target runs on two fixtures.

**edit.md**
- RISK-416 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-19. One line in the output style and `agents/Heracles.md` asks for a single `perl -pi` call when one change repeats across files.

**handover.md**
- RISK-132 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19, but only for options the user refused. The handover keeps every user correction, refusal and consent word for word.

I did not re-run the probes or fixtures these entries cite. "Settled" here means the register records a settled status and a Verified line, which the checker confirms. It does not mean I confirmed the underlying fixes.
